links.comparator_used: Standard PET/CT read-out using PET plus low-dose thick-slice CT (5 mm) versus PET/dCT/CAD using diagnostic thin-slice CT (1 mm) plus CAD
links.effect: Three readers detected 282 LN in 53 patients with CAD versus 121 LN in 37 patients using lCT; sensitivity/specificity for diagnosis of metastases were 95.6%/64.3% for PET/CAD versus 80.0%/81.9% for PET/lCT.
links.tradeoff: Specificity was lower with PET/CAD than PET/lCT (64.3% vs 81.9%); average evaluation time was longer than lCT (40 s vs 31 s); no significant difference was observed regarding ROC AUC.
links.quote: The combination of diagnostic thin-slice CT and CAD significantly increases the detection rate of lung nodules in tumor patients compared to the standard PET/CT read-out.

design_hint: CAD as second reader added to PET/CT read-out
